crises.title: Ground handling strike at Orlando and Philadelphia
crises.text: Workers at Kestrel Air's ground handling contractor (baggage handlers, cabin cleaners, wheelchair agents and fuelers) have announced a 48-hour strike at Orlando (MCO) and Philadelphia (PHL) on Tuesday, December 22 and Wednesday, December 23. The contractor says it will bring in replacement staff "where it can". Turnarounds will be slower; some flights may be late or canceled. The union says the strike "may be extended". Talks continue.
crises.reading: Medium scenario (research/field-research.md section 5): replacement staff cover part of the work, so a quarter of flights touching MCO/PHL on the strike days are canceled, the rest run about 3 hours late, bags and wheelchair help are slow. A backup ground handling contract cuts cancellations to about a third of that. We do not assume an extension in the base case.
